scope_description: Installation of new flooring throughout a home, including material selection, preparation of subfloor, removal of existing flooring, and installation.
Full kitchen remodel including cabinets, countertops, flooring, appliances, plumbing, and electrical work. Labor typically 20-25% of budget.
Includes demolition, installation of flooring, wall coverings, fixtures, and associated plumbing/electrical work. Labor is at least 50% of cost.
Removing old roof, repairing underlayment, and installing new material. Labor accounts for 40-50% of total cost.
Constructing extra square footage. Labor is roughly 30-50% of overall project cost.
Installation or replacement of windows including style, size, and glass pane type selection and labor.
Installation of countertops, including material and labor for a typical 30 sq ft project.
Installation of hardwood flooring for typical residential space.
Installation of laminate flooring, including underlayment and material selection.
Installation of a paver patio (approx 400 sq ft) including base layers, grading, and labor.
Installing or replacing a central or split AC unit in a U.S. home.
Installation of granite countertops covering roughly 30 sq ft.
Involves waterproofing, drywall, electrical, plumbing, and flooring. Labor is 25-30% of total.
Installing vinyl siding including material and labor.
Installation of new carpet including selecting material, padding, and disposal of old carpet.
Installation of a new water heater including removal and connection.
Installation of a new furnace with existing ductwork.
Installation of quartz countertops with cost varying by square footage and grade.
Painting home exterior. Labor accounts for 80-85% of total cost.
Installation of a new fence. Labor typically accounts for at least half of the total project cost.
